QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: hiddenRestrictions
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Bit mask of the geozone restrictions which are not drawn on maps. Checks and alerts still apply to them.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: alertsEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Alert when a connected vehicle approaches or enters an active restricted geozone or U-space airspace.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: logAlerts
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Append flight alerts to a CSV file per day in the telemetry folder of the application load/save path.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: approachDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Horizontal distance from a geozone at which the vehicle is alerted that it approaches the zone.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: approachVerticalDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Vertical distance below the floor or above the ceiling of a geozone within which the vehicle is considered close to the zone.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: approachTime
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Seconds before the vehicle would enter a geozone at its current speed, direction and climb rate at which it is alerted. 0 alerts by distance only.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: qnhHPa
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Local sea level pressure (altimeter setting) used to convert geozone limits published as flight levels to approximate heights above mean sea level. 1013.25 hPa is the standard pressure of flight levels.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: feedRefreshHours
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hours after which downloaded geozone feeds are downloaded again.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: liveFeedRefreshMinutes
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minutes after which feeds of temporary flight restrictions, which change during the day, are downloaded again.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: staleDays
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Age in days after which the data of a geozone source is reported as outdated.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: followAreaOfInterest
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Download services around the mission and vehicle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Download the zones of geozone services taking an area again when the planned mission or the active vehicle leaves the area downloaded.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: areaOfInterestMargin
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Distance around the planned mission and the active vehicle for which geozone services taking an area are downloaded.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: liveStaleHours
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Age in hours after which the data of a temporary flight restriction feed is reported as outdated.
